import MusicDB from '@/Structures/Schemas/MusicDB.js'
import type { PaperClient } from '@/Structures/classes/PaperClient.js'
import emojis from '@/libs/emoji/emoji.js'
import {
    ActionRowBuilder,
    ButtonBuilder,
    ButtonInteraction,
    ButtonStyle,
    ChatInputCommandInteraction,
    EmbedBuilder,
    Guild,
    InteractionResponse,
    Message,
    TextChannel,
    VoiceChannel,
    type MessageActionRowComponentBuilder
} from 'discord.js'
import { Player, Track } from 'moonlink.js'

// ==================== Constants ====================

const PROGRESS_BAR_LENGTH = 22
const DEFAULT_DELETE_TIME = 15 * 1000
const VOLUME_MAX = 100
const VOLUME_MIN = 0

// ==================== Utility Functions ====================

/**
 * 閮??脣漲璇?圈??? * ?湔嚗????湔嚗???莎?瘥?10 蝘?? */
const getInterval = (track: Track): number => {
    if (track.isStream) return 60 * 1000
    return 10 * 1000
}

export class MusicService {
    // ==================== Time Formatting ====================

    /**
     * 撠神蝘?? HH:MM:SS ??MM:SS 摮葡
     */
    static millisToDuration(millis: number): string {
        const totalSeconds = Math.floor(millis / 1000)
        const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600)
        const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60)
        const secs = totalSeconds % 60

        const pad = (num: number): string => num.toString().padStart(2, '0')

        if (hours > 0) {
            return `${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(secs)}`
        }
        return `${pad(minutes)}:${pad(secs)}`
    }

    /**
     * 撠??賂?摮葡?摮?頧??箸??瑕?銝?     */
    static secondsToDuration(seconds: string | number): string {
        const totalSeconds =
            typeof seconds === 'string' ? parseInt(seconds, 10) : Math.floor(seconds)
        return MusicService.millisToDuration(totalSeconds * 1000)
    }

    // ==================== UI Builders ====================

    /**
     * ???單??剜?函?????     */
    static generateMusicStatusButtons(player: Player) {
        const createButton = (
            customId: string,
            emoji: string,
            style: ButtonStyle,
            disabled = false
        ) =>
            new ButtonBuilder()
                .setCustomId(customId)
                .setEmoji(emoji)
                .setStyle(style)
                .setDisabled(disabled)

        const row1 = new ActionRowBuilder<MessageActionRowComponentBuilder>().addComponents([
            createButton(
                'autoplay',
                emojis.update,
                player.autoPlay ? ButtonStyle.Success : ButtonStyle.Secondary
            ),
            createButton(
                'previous',
                emojis.backforward,
                ButtonStyle.Secondary,
                player.previous.length === 0
            ),
            createButton(
                'togglePause',
                player.paused ? emojis.play : emojis.pause,
                player.paused ? ButtonStyle.Primary : ButtonStyle.Secondary
            ),
            createButton(
                'skip',
                emojis.frontforward,
                ButtonStyle.Secondary,
                player.autoPlay ? false : player.queue.tracks.length <= 1
            ),
            createButton('shuffle', emojis.shuffle, ButtonStyle.Secondary)
        ])

        const row2 = new ActionRowBuilder<MessageActionRowComponentBuilder>().addComponents([
            createButton(
                'loop',
                emojis.loop2,
                player.loop !== 'off' ? ButtonStyle.Success : ButtonStyle.Secondary
            ),
            createButton(
                'volumeDown',
                emojis.speaker_low,
                ButtonStyle.Secondary,
                player.volume <= VOLUME_MIN
            ),
            createButton('stop', emojis.stop, ButtonStyle.Danger),
            createButton(
                'volumeUp',
                emojis.speaker,
                ButtonStyle.Secondary,
                player.volume >= VOLUME_MAX
            ),
            createButton('related', emojis.add, ButtonStyle.Secondary)
        ])

        const row3 = new ActionRowBuilder<MessageActionRowComponentBuilder>().addComponents([
            createButton('queue', emojis.queue, ButtonStyle.Secondary),
            createButton('addSong', emojis.friend, ButtonStyle.Secondary),
            createButton('lyrics', emojis.list, ButtonStyle.Secondary),
            createButton('playlist:save', emojis.download, ButtonStyle.Secondary)
        ])

        return [row1, row2, row3]

export function registerMoonlinkEvents(client: PaperClient): void {
    if (!client.moonlink) return

    /** ----- Node Events ----- */
    client.moonlink.on('nodeConnected', (node: INode) =>
        Logger.info(`Node ${node.identifier} connected!`)
    )
    client.moonlink.on('nodeReady', (node, stats) => {
        console.info(`Node ${node.identifier} is ready`, stats)
    })
    client.moonlink.on('nodeReconnect', (node) => {
        console.info(`[NODE] Reconnection attempt:`, {
            identifier: node.identifier,
            attempt: node.retryAmount,
            delay: node.retryDelay
        })
    })
    client.moonlink.on('nodeDisconnect', (node: INode, code, reason) => {
        console.info(`Node ${node.identifier} disconnected`, {
            identifier: node.identifier,
            code: code,
            reason: reason
        })
    })
    client.moonlink.on('nodeError', (node: INode, error: Error) =>
        Logger.error(error, `Node ${node.identifier} error:`, {
            identifier: node.identifier,
            error: {
                name: error.name,
                message: error.message,
                stack: error.stack
            }
        })
    )
    client.moonlink.on('nodeDestroy', (identifier) => {
        console.info(`[NODE] Destroyed:`, {
            identifier: identifier,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        })
    })

        try {

import type { ButtonInteraction, GuildMember } from 'discord.js'
import type { Player } from 'moonlink.js'

export default {
    id: 'skip',
    async execute(interaction: ButtonInteraction, client: PaperClient) {
        await interaction.deferReply()
        const member = interaction.member! as GuildMember
        const VoiceChannel = member.voice.channel

        if (!(await validateVoiceChannel(interaction, client, VoiceChannel))) return

        const player = client.moonlink?.players.get(interaction.guildId!) as Player

                .editReply({
                    content: `${emojis.warning} | ?桀?瘝?甇??剜?璅?`
                })
                .then(deleteMessageAfter)

                .editReply({
                    content: `${emojis.outage} | ??敺?擐?鈭?`
                })
                .then(deleteMessageAfter)
        }

        await player.skip()

        return await interaction
            .editReply({
                content: `${emojis.frontforward} | ??頝喲?甇`
            })
            .then(deleteMessageAfter)
    }
} satisfies ButtonType

import { Player } from 'moonlink.js'

export class MusicStateManager {
    static getControllerMessageId(player: Player) {
        return player.data.musicControllerMsgId as string
    }

    static setControllerMessageId(player: Player, messageId: string) {
        player.set('musicControllerMsgId', messageId)
    }

    static resetControllerMessageId(player: Player) {
        player.set('musicControllerMsgId', undefined)
    }
}
